notes.title: Update for 2/26/2025
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Camera systems maintenance
[*] Cinematic cameras implemented with auto focus
[*] Scroll wheel acts as zoom input for all controlled cameras, middle mouse button to reset
[*] Keys 2 through 7 are independent Free cameras
[*] Prototype phone camera mode added, 8 enables the phone camera, 9 toggles front/rear camera
[*] Nuke, Give Weapon & Drop Weapon interactions added
[*] Prototype mocap melee hit detection, when in a mocap mode swing the weapon fast enough to hit
[*] < and > keys adjust voice chat range through modes; Whisper, Talk (Default), Yell & Global. Global is restricted to streamers and those granted moderator of the session
[*] Various fixes, improvements, and minor optimizations
[/list]

notes.title: Update for Dec 30, 2024
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed items from the previous session showing up when joining a new session
[*] Improved performance for owners of a large number of items in a session
[*] Updated avatar texture compression to handle textures that are not a power of 2 in size; texture width/height must still be divisible by 4 to be compressed though
[/list]

notes.title: UI changes and texture compression
notes.content:
This update includes work-in-progress UI changes and texture compression for registered avatars.

[list]
[*] The main interface is now toggled on and off with Escape instead of Tab
[*] Logout/Quit moved to the main menu
[*] Registering an avatar will generate compressed textures that are saved on the server
[*] Existing registered avatars can have compressed textures added by going to the Edit screen for the avatar
[/list]

notes.title: MikoVerse Early Alpha Available Now!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Everyone![/b][/h1]

The [b]MikoVerse Early Alpha[/b] is now available for everyone! Get access by requesting access on our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1914710/MikoVerse/][b]store page[/b][/url], then head over to your game library to find it, [b]download[/b] and [b]play![/b] 💫

For any questions or feedback, feel free to join us on [url=https://discord.gg/mikoverse][b]Discord[/b][/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43715419/f0ff4deb126bd3a4760fd3fde84d164dee25ae0c.png[/img]

[h2]The AI Companion Creator[/h2]

The AI Companion Creator is an [b]extra feature[/b] which allows you to create an AI character by importing your own VRM model or selecting from the default character screen. You’ll be able to write custom prompts to design unique character personalities, resulting in NPC-like companions with rich, personal interactions to keep you company in the MikoVerse!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43715419/6ec97217164da8800c746aa33a02d8720422170d.png[/img]

The AI Companion Creator lets you bring your companion to life in multiplayer or private servers, creating a dynamic world filled with vibrant NPCs. This opens up new storytelling possibilities, allowing you to share unique experiences with other players. You can direct your AI companions to follow you and interact in a variety of ways, expanding your gameplay in ways never before possible. Whether you're live streaming, creating YouTube content, making TikToks, or just enjoying it for personal use, the AI Companion Creator offers endless opportunities to craft engaging, fun experiences.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1914710/MikoVerse/][img]https://i.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExOTMzMzVsbXQ2eXFvOTV6em9kbTI2MG94ZTM5amlsa2ttamN3ZzZkZyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/omkj2fbt6F8IpHS8hy/giphy.gif[/img][/url]

The AI Companion Creator operates on a subscription model, where $23 per month grants you 1,000 interactions. Keep in mind, this feature is in its early stages, and we’ll continue to improve and expand it over time.

[b]You don't need the AI Companion Creator to enjoy MikoVerse multiplayer[/b] and it isn't an AI art generator; you'll need to use your own models or those available as default in MikoVerse.

- [i]The MikoVerse Team[/i]

notes.title: Changes for build 6365
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The voice chat system can now be toggled with F5. This will disable your voice being sent to other users as well as receiving their voice chat.

[/list]

notes.title: Stability and Backend Update
notes.content: We have patched various things related to loading a large amount of entities in a session. This should hopefully make for a smoother time inside the MikoVerse.

notes.title: The Persistent Object Patch
notes.content:
Objects are now persistent!

With this, many systems may see an increase in instability.

Please report all issues!

notes.title: Feb 16th Stress test
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Thanks for participating in our app stress test today!

Lots of things will go wrong, but hopefully if a few things go right, we can fix what goes wrong and we can do this again better, faster, and sooner!

Shout out to NyaTokki and all volunteers who have helped organize our discord for the betterment of communicating with engineering.

* More development on store/wardrobe features, still very WIP
* Wardrobe assets / loading avatars may be slow (10-20 seconds) for now
* More development with session joining/hopping, sudden disconnects on password failure are still currently a thing
* Improvements to VRM texture loading and material generation
* Improvements to external file loading
* AFK nameplate system
* Bug fixes to various UI elements
* Basic inventory and platform rights have been added
* Prototype minigame levels added
* Stability fixes
* Experimental "single window" mode, currently has some UX issues
* And other minor changes!

notes.title: Post Initial Stress Test Update
notes.content:
Thanks everyone helping us test this app in its current state, and more thanks to those helping the onboarding of others. We've learned some things.

[b]IN THIS BUILD, THERE IS AN ABILITY TO BUY A CURRENCY THAT CURRENTLY HAS NO MECHANISM TO SPEND. THE STORE IS IN PROGRESS.[/b]

* Beginning of money signaling from stripe
* Improvements to the "worlds all loading at origin" problem
* Improvements to handling of Twitch events
* Improvements to account based activities (more info later)
* Minor improvements to UI
* Fixes to AutoDOF
* Initial StretchSense glove support
* Background work on new labyrinth map, *soon*

notes.title: Improved VRM Loading Speed and fixed skin binding on tracking morph targets
notes.content:
* WIP InputMapping widgets that dynamically populate from enhanced input
* Adding Premium collection tag to several interactions due to be sold
* AnimSolve and Seated logic work to support properly handling avatar seated offsetting on the avatar, post-retarget, so HumanoidOffsets are no longer eyeballed to offset Quinn to account for the avatar
* Input pass, player mappable info populated, various things consolidated and tidied, minor behavior changes but overall mostly the same, attempted to untangle the mess for future changes
* `IJKL,UO` input for offsetting avatar in all contexts, can use it for adjusting avatar position, e.g. when seated adjust to sit properly
* Experimental Auto FOV/DOF for ThirdPersonCam
* Fix morph targets for vrm import
